data.name: MWG_001
data.value: The summit...[pause=15] We're almost there.

data.name: MWG_002
data.value: Look at the sky...[pause=15] Those clouds aren't normal.

data.name: MWG_003
data.value: Is that...[pause=10] a storm?!

data.name: MWG_004
data.value: An...[pause=10] AN AERODACTYL!

data.name: MWG_005
data.value: The Ancient Sky Predator...

data.name: MWG_006
data.value: You...[pause=10] You knew it was here!

data.name: MWG_007
data.value: The mountain's ultimate guardian.[pause=20] It ruled these skies long before anyone set foot on this land.

data.name: MWG_008
data.value: If you triumph here, the path to the ancestral ruins will open to you.

data.name: MWG_009
data.value: Fail...[pause=30] and your journey ends here.

data.name: MWG_010
data.value: Then let's show it our journey is just beginning![pause=10] [player], let's do this!

data.name: MWG_011
data.value: This time, we take it down.[pause=15] I promise, [player].

data.name: MWG_012
data.value: We...[pause=10] We beat it!

data.name: MWG_013
data.value: Look![pause=10] The storm is clearing...

data.name: MWG_014
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It said something about ancestral ruins.

data.name: MWG_015
data.value: That's where we're going.[pause=20] To the Cloven Ruins.

data.name: MWG_016
data.value: Then let's go![pause=15] The end of the expedition awaits us!

data.name: MWG_017
data.value: The ancient predator shows no mercy...

data.name: MWG_018
data.value: But today's prey is tomorrow's hunter.

data.name: MWG_019
data.value: Rest now.[pause=30] The summit will wait for you.

data.name: MWG_020
data.value: I...[pause=5] I can't stand anymore...[pause=15] The Aerodactyl is too powerful!

data.name: MWG_021
data.value: The Aerodactyl lets out a piercing screech that tears through the sky.[pause=15] It towers over you.

data.name: MWG_022
data.value: You are not the first to fall,[pause=20] little climber.[pause=25] And you won't be the last.

data.name: MWG_023
data.value: It rises back into the storm with two wingbeats.[pause=20] The mountain still trembles.

data.name: MWG_024
data.value: The ancient predator collapses in a cloud of dust.[pause=15] The storm clears.

data.name: MWG_025
data.value: The Aerodactyl looks at you, panting.[pause=20] Then it lowers its head.

data.name: MWG_026
data.value: You have defeated the king of these skies.[pause=25] I... I never thought I'd see this.[pause=30] Go. The summit is yours.

data.name: MWG_027
data.value: It spreads its wings one last time and disappears into the clouds.[pause=15] Silence returns.

data.name: MWG_028
data.value: We...[pause=10] WE BEAT IT![pause=15] The summit is ours!

data.name: MWG_029
data.value: The oldest predator bows before you.[pause=25] You are changing the rules of this world.
